notes: Adds a local rotating debug log for Wallet captures and failures. Open Wallet Counter → Debug log to view recent entries, share/copy the full log, or clear it. Logs include engine version and the raw Amount/Currency/Merchant/Name field types and values needed to diagnose Wallet/Shortcut issues; card value is not logged. Missing merchant handling, SL estimates, FX, resets, and history are unchanged. No Shortcut changes.
